messages:
amira: heads-up, seeing a perf regression on mixtral-7b at seq=1024 after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. p50 ~120ms OK but p99 jumped from ~260ms to ~520ms. appears we're falling back a lot.
jon: can you dump the profiler + runtime logs? suspect flash/SDPA selector flip.
amira: profiler snippet:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:01Z model=mixtral-7b batch=8 seq=1024
kernel_choice: flashattention (checked) -> fallback: triton_sdpa
flash_status: ineligible (head_dim=40)
kv_cache_hits: 0.97
latencies_ms: p50=120 p95=260 p99=520
notes: mask_prep_time increased
```
sasha: head_dim=40, yep. flashattn rejects head_dim not multiple of 8 (ideally 16). fallback to SDPA/Triton adds mask handling and extra memcpy.
kai: confirmed. the selector change yesterday tightened heuristics so odd head dims prefer triton_sdpa. that explains the sudden p99 spike.
jon: can you attach a single-request repro with debug logs (kernel choice, kv offsets)?
amira: quick repro snippet:
```
REQUEST id=abc123 model=mixtral-7b seq=1024 batch=1
KVCACHE: offset=129874 kv_len=1024
KERNEL: choose -> triton_sdpa
```
also saw maskgen log repeatedly hitting `if (unaligned) -> scalar_mask_copy` on CPU.
perf-bot: quick perf diff for that request:
```
compute_gpu_ms: 38
mask_prep_cpu_ms: 180
gpu_kernel_ms: 60
total_ms: 278 (vs 120 baseline)
```
jon: mask prep on CPU is the big culprit. options: 1) pad head_dim in model (invasive), 2) implement a GPU mask path in Triton kernel, or 3) add a flashattn_pad runtime wrapper that pads on-the-fly and prefers flash.
sasha: padding model configs is painful across variants. prefer runtime-level padding that canonicalizes KV view for attention calls. need to be careful about kv cache index math and checksums.
kai: practical approach: keep raw KV storage unchanged, create a padded view for kernel calls (pad keys/values to next multiple of 8), invoke flashattn, then discard padded buffers. avoids catalog churn.
amira: concern: copy overhead for pad/unpad. any benchmarks?
jon: ran a microbenchmark on A100: pad-copy (GPU memcpy + small kernel) ~14ms for seq=1024; scalar mask copy on host ~160ms for same shape. pad-copy wins by a lot.
sasha: also found a masking branch bug in SDPA for seq%warp==1 that causes extra branching and CPU fallback behavior. PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4121 fixes it and cuts CPU mask prep ~30%.
amira: proposed plan:
- short-term: add runtime pad-to-8 wrapper for FlashAttention calls, feature-flagged as `runtime.kernel_override=flashattn_pad8` and canary it today
- medium-term: merge SDPA mask branch fix (PR 4121), add selector telemetry and CI tests for odd head dims
- long-term: evaluate promoting padded model variants in model-catalog or canonicalizing configs
jon: I'll own the canary. will add a perf harness and checksum test to ensure KV eviction/checksum invariants hold.
deploy-bot: canary: starting rollout to 5% prod poly clusters (region us-west-2)  id=canary-1989991111
amira: adding traces + repro to INF-4321, linking PRs and perf graphs. tagging @sasha @kai for review. :thumbsup:
sasha: quick nit: ensure kv cache checksum unchanged when using the padded view so eviction logic remains valid.
jon: added checksum assertions in the canary harness. will post results in ~30m.
amira: thanks all. if canary looks good we'll flip selector default and add selector telemetry to catch regressions earlier.
